mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APT_ANN_BOARD_POST P INNER JOIN APT_BOARD_INSTANCE B ON P.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.BOARD_TY_CD = 'NOTICE' AND B.APT_CMPLEX_NO = #{aptCmplexNo} AND P.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
AND P.ANN_NO LIKE '%' || #{searchAnnNo} || '%'
AND P.TTL LIKE '%' || #{searchTtl} || '%'
AND P.WRTR_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchWrtrId} || '%'
AND TRUNC(P.REG_DTTM) >= TO_DATE(#{searchStartDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(P.REG_DTTM) <= TO_DATE(#{searchEndDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND P.TOP_FIX_YN = 'Y'
AND P.ATCH_FILE_ID IS NOT NULL

/* * MEMBER.USER_NM에 이미 단지명이 포함되어 있으면 그대로 사용. * 포함되어 있지 않으면 단지명_사용자명 형태로 생성. */ SELECT CASE WHEN M.USER_NM LIKE A.APT_CMPLEX_NM || '_%' THEN M.USER_NM ELSE A.APT_CMPLEX_NM || '_' || M.USER_NM END AS WRTR_NM FROM APT_COMPLEX A INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON M.USER_NO = #{userNo} WHERE A.APT_CMPLEX_NO = #{aptCmplexNo}

SELECT P.ANN_NO , P.BOARD_NO , B.APT_CMPLEX_NO , P.TTL , P.CN , P.WRTR_ID , P.REG_DTTM , P.MDF_DTTM , NVL(P.INQ_CNT, 0) AS INQ_CNT , P.DEL_YN , P.ATCH_FILE_ID , P.TOP_FIX_YN FROM APT_ANN_BOARD_POST P INNER JOIN APT_BOARD_INSTANCE B ON P.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE P.ANN_NO = #{annNo} AND P.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND B.APT_CMPLEX_NO = #{aptCmplexNo} AND B.BOARD_TY_CD = 'NOTICE' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTACH_FILE ( FILE_GROUP_NO , FILE_OG_NAME , FILE_SAVE_UUID , FILE_PATH , FILE_EXT , FILE_SIZE , MIME_TYPE , REG_DT , FILE_SORT_ORDER , DOWN_CNT , CAT ) VALUES ( TO_NUMBER(#{atchFileId}) , #{fileOgName} , #{fileSaveUuid} , #{filePath} , #{fileExt} , #{fileSize} , #{mimeType} , SYSDATE , 1 , 0 , 'NOTICE' )
